args: Fan-out-safe date classification of the 2025 active-bucket orphan orders

Rebuilt carefully so the category counts and the discount total come from the same population: of the 2025 orphan orders whose customer's most-recent subscription is 'active', how many had that subscription start after the order, how many show active status despite an already-past end date, and how many have dates that should have overlapped (a bug)?
